name: tabbar
title: Tab bar
description: The main destinations of a small-screen app, along the bottom edge.
use: Three to five destinations of equal weight that a reader moves between all day, on a small screen. It sticks to the bottom of its scroll container and keeps clear of the home indicator. Keep each label to one word.

instead.when: The items switch between views of one page
The screen is wide and the destinations go along the top
The screen is wide and the destinations stack in a sidebar

classes.name: tabbar
classes.description: The bar, sticky at the bottom, on a nav with a label: a pane of frosted glass whose items share its width equally

classes.name: tabbar-floating
classes.description: A bar lifted off the edge, with a margin, a surface corner and a floating shadow

classes.name: tabbar-item
classes.description: A destination: an icon over a tabbar-label, on a link or a button

classes.name: tabbar-label
classes.description: The word under the icon, on one line, cut with an ellipsis before it pushes its neighbors

states.name: current
states.description: On a link: strong ink, and the icon rests on a soft pill

states.name: selected
states.description: On a role="tab" item that switches panels in place: drawn the same

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link: disabled ink

properties.name: --tabbar-color
properties.description: The color the pane is tinted with

example: Home Search Library
